svg.text: Six human head families plus the dedicated FAB machine head.

svg.title: Terrarium Point head east authored art
svg.desc: A directional profile with an explicit nose and low pointed chin.

svg.title: Terrarium Point head north authored art
svg.desc: Rear pointed contour without front-facing detail.

svg.title: Terrarium Point head south authored art
svg.desc: Wide cheeks converge into a centered pointed chin.

svg.title: Terrarium Block head east authored art
svg.desc: A squared directional profile with an explicit nose and level jaw.

svg.title: Terrarium Block head north authored art
svg.desc: Rear block contour without front-facing detail.

svg.title: Terrarium Block head south authored art
svg.desc: Straight cheek walls and a broad level jaw create the Block family.

svg.title: IRIS fabrication unit head — east
svg.desc: Directional chamfered chassis with its optic on the forward sensor plane.

svg.title: IRIS fabrication unit head — north
svg.desc: Rear chassis service panel with a readable IRIS status tell.

svg.title: IRIS fabrication unit head — south
svg.desc: Chamfered chassis, dark sensor band, and the shared IRIS optic.

svg.title: Terrarium head-long east authored art
svg.desc: Elongated profile with fixed ear-line width and a low chin.

svg.title: Terrarium head-long north authored art
svg.desc: Rear elongated contour without front-facing detail.

svg.title: Terrarium head-long south authored art
svg.desc: Narrow upper face widening at the ear line before a long tapered chin.

svg.title: Terrarium Broad head east authored art
svg.desc: A wide directional profile with an explicit nose and compact lower face.

svg.title: Terrarium Broad head north authored art
svg.desc: Rear broad contour without front-facing detail.

svg.title: Terrarium Broad head south authored art
svg.desc: A wide crown and cheek span create a low, broad head family; eyes remain stable literal-ink detail.
